en: The hard work and loyalty that someone gives to a job or cause; or a short message at the front of a book honoring someone.
ex: Her dedication to her students was admired by everyone.
大家都欽佩她對學生的奉獻。

en: A chance to see something such as a movie or exhibition before it is shown to the public; or to look at something first.
ex: We went to a preview of the new film last night.
昨晚我們去看了這部新電影的試映。

en: One of two imaginary lines around the Earth, north and south of the equator; or the hot area between them.
ex: The Tropic of Cancer passes through southern Taiwan.
北回歸線穿過台灣南部。

en: Goods that are bought and sold; or to promote the sale of products.
ex: The shop sells official merchandise of the football team.
這家店販售足球隊的官方商品。

en: A continuous, fast shaking movement; or a feeling of excitement or tension.
ex: The vibration of the washing machine shook the floor.
洗衣機的震動使地板顫動。

en: Birds such as chickens, ducks and geese that are kept for their meat and eggs; or the meat of these birds.
ex: The farm raises poultry and sells eggs.
這座農場養家禽並販賣雞蛋。

en: Something you agree to give up in an argument; a special right to do business; or a reduced price for certain groups.
ex: The union made some concessions to reach an agreement.
工會作出一些讓步以達成協議。

en: The business or industry of catching fish; or a place where fish are caught or raised.
ex: The fishery supports the economy of the small coastal town.
漁業支撐著這個沿海小鎮的經濟。

en: An official skill, degree or certificate that makes someone suitable for a job; or a limit on a statement.
ex: She has all the qualifications needed for the job.
她具備這份工作需要的全部資格條件。

en: To arrange things in a straight line; or to join with a group or an idea.
ex: Make sure the edges of the paper are properly aligned.
確保紙張的邊緣對齊。

en: To stop someone from doing something, often by using force; or to control your own feelings.
ex: It took three men to restrain the angry crowd.
要三個人才能壓制住憤怒的群眾。

en: To start a fire; or to start a feeling or interest in someone.
ex: The teacher's passion kindled a love of science in her students.
老師的熱情激起了學生們對科學的熱愛。

en: An official who makes sure players follow the rules in a game such as soccer; or a person who settles a dispute.
ex: The referee blew his whistle to end the match.
裁判吹哨結束了比賽。

en: The end of a period during which something is valid; or the act of breathing out.
ex: Check the expiration date on the milk carton.
檢查牛奶盒上的到期日。

en: A rude, violent person or someone from an uncivilized society, as seen by ancient peoples.
ex: The Roman Empire was invaded by barbarian tribes.
羅馬帝國遭到蠻族部落入侵。

en: A break or crack in a bone; or to break or cause something to break.
ex: The X-ray showed a fracture in his left arm.
X光顯示他的左臂骨折。

en: A person who loves their country and is ready to defend it.
ex: He considered himself a patriot and served in the army.
他自認是愛國者，並在軍中服役。

en: Using careful, logical thinking to examine something; or relating to the separation of something into parts for study.
ex: The job requires strong analytical skills.
這份工作需要很強的分析能力。

en: Severe action taken by authorities to control or stop illegal or unwanted behavior.
ex: The government announced a crackdown on illegal gambling.
政府宣布嚴厲取締非法賭博。

en: To make something more varied; or to expand a business into new areas.
ex: The company plans to diversify into new markets.
公司計畫多元化進軍新市場。

en: Relating to surgery, the medical treatment that involves cutting the body; or used in an operation.
ex: The surgeon wore a surgical mask during the operation.
外科醫生在手術中戴著外科口罩。

en: Not able to be damaged by fire.
ex: The documents are kept in a fireproof safe.
文件存放在防火保險箱裡。

en: A huge mass of ice floating in the sea, with most of it under the water.
ex: The Titanic sank after hitting an iceberg.
鐵達尼號撞上冰山後沉沒。

en: The traditional stories, customs and beliefs of a people; or the study of these.
ex: The story comes from ancient Japanese folklore.
這個故事出自古老的日本民間傳說。

en: A feeling that something is true or will happen, without proof; or to bend forward with your back rounded.
ex: I have a hunch that she will win the competition.
我有種預感她會贏得比賽。

en: A person who pays rent to use a house, apartment or land.
ex: The tenant paid the rent on the first of every month.
房客每個月一號付租金。

en: Very high and noble in thought or aim; or proud and acting as if you are better than others.
ex: He set himself the lofty goal of ending world hunger.
他給自己定下了消除世界飢餓的崇高目標。

en: Friendly and generous toward guests or strangers; or (of a place) pleasant and welcoming.
ex: The villagers were warm and hospitable to the travelers.
村民們對旅人熱情好客。

en: Happening naturally without being planned or forced; or done without thinking in advance.
ex: The crowd burst into spontaneous applause.
群眾自發地爆出掌聲。

en: The quality of being unclear because something can be understood in more than one way.
ex: The contract contains some ambiguity that could cause problems.
這份合約有些含糊之處，可能引發問題。

en: Refusing to change your opinion or behavior, even when others say you are wrong.
ex: The obstinate old man refused to leave his house.
那位固執的老人拒絕離開他的房子。

en: To use computers to do a job or store information.
ex: The library has computerized all its records.
圖書館已把全部紀錄電腦化。

en: The way you hold your body when standing or sitting; or an attitude toward something.
ex: Good posture helps prevent back pain.
良好的姿勢有助於預防背痛。

en: To frighten someone so that they do what you want.
ex: The gang tried to intimidate the witnesses.
那個幫派企圖恐嚇證人。

en: Products such as lipstick and powder that you put on your face to make yourself look more attractive.
ex: She works for a company that sells cosmetics.
她在一家賣化妝品的公司工作。

en: A thin, flat part on a fish's body that helps it swim; or an object shaped like this on a shark, aircraft or swimmer's foot.
ex: We saw a shark's fin cutting through the water.
我們看到鯊魚的背鰭劃破水面。

en: The act of keeping someone in a place, such as police custody; or a punishment in which a student must stay at school after class.
ex: The boy was given detention for talking in class.
那個男孩因為上課說話被罰留校。

en: A substance put on the skin to make it look more beautiful; or relating to improving appearance only.
ex: The company made only cosmetic changes to the product.
公司只對產品做了表面的改變。

en: To leave someone or something completely; or to give up an idea or habit.
ex: He forsook his career to take care of his sick mother.
他放棄事業去照顧生病的母親。

en: A sport in which two people hit each other with their fists, wearing padded gloves.
ex: He has trained in boxing since he was twelve.
他從十二歲起就練拳擊。
